name: Skirt Steak with Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients_verbatim: 700g flat iron, flank, or skirt steak
why: Squarely mid-band on the source's own numbers: 491 cal / 2g carb / 38g protein per serving. Whole-muscle beef (skirt/flank/flat-iron) + herb-oil sauce is structurally near-zero-carb (no rice/pasta/potato/bread/bean), so it clears the 35g carb ceiling with huge margin and the calories sit right in the 450-600 sweet spot. Sear-and-slice skillet method scales cleanly to 14 with weigh-and-divide; chimichurri batches trivially. Distinct from flank-steak-parmesan-green-beans (already taken this run) and no chimichurri/skirt dish in the 544-recipe catalog. Board tracks sirloin/ribeye/chuck but not skirt/flank/flat-iron cut - flagged as unmapped per the pricer-lane exercise (the recipe rebuilds fine on sirloin-steak if the board prefers, but the cut is left flagged for the selector). Fresh parsley/oregano, red wine vinegar, and red pepper flakes also flagged as possible board gaps.
confidence: high on source numbers - nutrition read directly from the recipe card
